eyebrow: Microsoft Fabric & Real-Time Analytics · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 34 · Real-Time Data Engineering

code:
Late (Lesson 33):       arrives past the watermark's tolerance
Out-of-order (here):    arrives WITHIN tolerance,
                        just not in the sequence it happened
caption: A network retry or two producers writing near-simultaneously, typically.

code:
RawTripEvents
| extend ArrivalGap = ingestion_time() - EventTime
| where ArrivalGap > 30s
| project TripId, EventTime, ArrivalGap
| order by ArrivalGap desc
caption: Doesn't fix anything -- just makes the gap visible.

items.label: Tolerate it
items.sub: count()/sum() come out the same regardless of arrival order

items.label: Widen the watermark
items.sub: Buys more time to settle when order genuinely matters

items.label: Route it separately
items.sub: Send failed-sequence events to a distinct destination (Lesson 36)

subtitle: Shaping data as it flows, not after it lands.
